decisions.title: What an explicit null sends, per nullable body argument
decisions.context: PATCH /gizmos/{id} documents that an explicit null `memo` clears the stored memo, while omitting `memo` entirely leaves the existing value unchanged -- an explicit-null case for `memo` is required, distinct from omission. Source: vendor docs, "Updating a gizmo" section.

resolution.decision: send null for every nullable body argument.
